zakat.claim_evidence: No explicit mention of "zakat" or "zakat donations" was found on the official website of Support Life Foundation (www.supportlives.org) or its donation pages in the provided search results. While Support Life Foundation is involved in "Free Food Distribution" via the Muslim Community Association (MCA) of San Francisco Bay Area, and MCA lists a "Zakah Request" service, this does not constitute explicit acceptance of zakat donations by Support Life Foundation itself. (Source: https://goodmeasuregiving.org/charity/47-1675693/)

rich_narrative.summary: Support Life Foundation is a California-based organization focused on social and economic justice across several regional communities. In FY2024, the foundation reported <cite id="2">Total Revenue of $1,078,197</cite>, down from <cite id="2">$1,228,678 in FY2023</cite>. Despite this recent 12% single-year revenue decline, the foundation maintains direct community service operations in regions such as Fresno, Stanislaus County, Stockton, Fremont, and Sacramento. Financial filings in FY2024 show strong spending efficiency, allocating a <cite id="1">95.1% program expense ratio</cite> while spending less than one cent on fundraising for every dollar raised. However, overall institutional evaluation remains moderate, as reflected in its <cite id="1">Charity Navigator score of 63.0/100</cite>. The charity holds a 20/20 standard rating with the Better Business Bureau and maintains a Platinum Seal of Transparency with Candid, yet lacks a documented theory of change and complete board governance details. Giving to this foundation is considered sadaqah-eligible.
